test_title: PYST 78: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

His father's arm was bandaged by the kind nurse.

options.text: The kind nurse has bandaged his father's arm.
The kind nurse had bandaged his father's arm.
The kind nurse bandages his father's arm.
The kind nurse bandaged his father's arm.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The kind nurse bandaged his father's arm."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "his father's arm" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "bandaged" to "was bandaged" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the kind nurse."
 
• Ensure the sentence structure remains clear.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The kind nurse bandaged his father's arm."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The kind nurse has bandaged his father's arm." – Incorrect tense (present perfect).
 
• **Option 2: **"The kind nurse had bandaged his father's arm." – Incorrect tense (past perfect).
 
• **Option 3: **"The kind nurse bandages his father's arm." – Incorrect tense (present simple).

```
2f:T
